_about: Termbase of the external corpus (DOC-EXTERNAL-QUALITY rule 4): the site and the five READMEs. 'forms' is the word each locale uses for the concept - a stem, matched from a word start, and it must be in use. 'forbidden' are regular-expression fragments, matched case-insensitively from a word start, that must not appear in that locale's prose (code is not prose). Checked by packaging/check-external-docs.ps1; the glossary page (docs/guides/glossary.html) has one entry per term, id="term-<id>".

terms.concept: A .fd-sec file: one file packed under a password.
secure: pack a file into a .fd-sec container.
unsecure: bring the original back out of a container for good.
reveal: open the content of a container for one look, keeping nothing afterwards.
wipe: overwrite in place, then remove - not an ordinary delete.
fill: write test files until the free space is used up.
The capacity test: proves how much a drive really stores, which is how a fake drive is caught.
A drive that reports more capacity than it can hold.
